Hydrates so skin does not dry out

excerpt: A collagen mask you sleep in and rinse off in the morning.

Two or three nights a week

benefits: Use once or twice a week

Avoid broken or irritated skin.
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

name: Cica Peptide Anti Hair Loss Derma Scalp Treatment
excerpt: A centella and peptide scalp treatment for hair that is thinning.
description: Hair loss usually starts at the scalp rather than the strand, which is why this is formulated as skincare: centella to settle an irritated, flaking scalp and peptides to support the follicle underneath.
A clinical-solution tube with a nozzle that parts the hair, so the product reaches the scalp instead of sitting on the lengths.
benefits: Targets thinning and shedding at the root
Nozzle applies directly to the scalp, not the hair
howToUse: Part dry or towel-dried hair and apply along the scalp.
Massage in with your fingertips for a minute.
Leave in - there is no need to rinse.
Use once or twice daily, consistently, for at least eight weeks.
